## Activity

During February 2025, East City Eye Clinic completed 215 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained throughout the month. The clinic team supported the scheduled work and continued routine operational arrangements. There were no reported disruptions to the capture programme. Routine leave was managed within the existing staffing arrangements, allowing sessions to run as planned.

The activity level provides a clear basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. Records for the month were available for assessment, and the completed captures were taken forward for image review and grading.

## Image quality

Graders assessed 4 captures as ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 1.9. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images should continue to inform local quality monitoring and any discussion of capture technique or patient support.

## Grading

A total of 60 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3 days. Grading activity therefore continued alongside the capture programme, with results processed within the reported period. The findings should be reviewed with the clinic’s routine performance information to support ongoing oversight of service delivery.
